day3_afternoon_start.name: Me
day3_afternoon_start.text: *The final bell rings. Friday after school. A wave of freedom hits, mixed with a strange undercurrent of tension.*

day3_afternoon_check.name: Me
day3_afternoon_check.text: *I'm about to pack my bag when...*

day3_afternoon_tension.name: Me
day3_afternoon_tension.text: *The air in the classroom feels heavy. Probably because of what happened at lunch.*

day3_afternoon_confrontation.name: Me
day3_afternoon_confrontation.text: *Seoyeon pulls me out into the hallway. Her usual laid-back smile is nowhere to be found.*

day3_afternoon_confrontation_2.name: Seoyeon
day3_afternoon_confrontation_2.text: "About lunch. Every time you smiled at the others, I felt something crumble inside me. Be honest -- did you promise everyone the same weekend plans?"

day3_afternoon_confrontation_3.name: Me
choices: Say it's fine since the time slots are different
Tell her she's the only one I'm serious about

day3_afternoon_admit.name: Me
day3_afternoon_admit.text: "...Yeah. I'm sorry. I just couldn't say no."

day3_afternoon_admit_react.name: Seoyeon
day3_afternoon_admit_react.text: "Couldn't say no? You have no idea how devastating your half-hearted kindness is."

day3_afternoon_admit_react_2.name: Seoyeon
day3_afternoon_admit_react_2.text: "I don't want to be a piece of your kindness. If I'm not everything, I'd rather be nothing. Choose, {name}."

day3_afternoon_justify.name: Me
day3_afternoon_justify.text: "The time slots are all different... I figured I could see everyone..."

day3_afternoon_justify_react.name: Seoyeon
day3_afternoon_justify_react.text: "...Do you not understand that that's the problem?"

day3_afternoon_lie_seoyeon.name: Me
day3_afternoon_lie_seoyeon.text: "Seoyeon, you're the only one I'm serious about. The others are just..."

day3_afternoon_lie_seoyeon_react.name: Seoyeon
day3_afternoon_lie_seoyeon_react.text: "...Really? That... I can believe that, right?"

day3_afternoon_lie_warning.name: Me
day3_afternoon_lie_warning.text: *Seoyeon smiles. But... what am I going to tell the others?*

day3_afternoon_jealousy_check.name: Me
day3_afternoon_jealousy_check.text: *The mood was a little weird at lunch... it'll be fine, right?*

day3_afternoon_approach.name: Me
day3_afternoon_approach.text: *I pack my bag and stand up, and someone walks over.*

day3_afternoon_seoyeon_talk.name: Seoyeon
day3_afternoon_seoyeon_talk.text: "About lunch... sorry. I think I was being a bit sensitive."

day3_afternoon_seoyeon_talk_2.name: Seoyeon
day3_afternoon_seoyeon_talk_2.text: "But honestly, seeing you be all chummy with Yuna or Dain... it gets to me."

day3_afternoon_seoyeon_comfort.name: Seoyeon
day3_afternoon_seoyeon_comfort.text: "...Really? Hearing that does make me feel better."

day3_afternoon_yuna_talk.name: Yuna
day3_afternoon_yuna_talk.text: "At lunch... I saw where your eyes kept going."

day3_afternoon_yuna_talk_2.name: Me
day3_afternoon_yuna_talk_2.text: *Yuna's cool gaze cuts right through me.*

day3_afternoon_yuna_apologize.name: Yuna
day3_afternoon_yuna_apologize.text: "I don't want an apology. I want you to understand the weight of choosing whose side you stand on."

day3_afternoon_yuna_question.name: Yuna
day3_afternoon_yuna_question.text: "...Upset? No. I just wanted to confirm something."

day3_afternoon_yuna_warning.name: Yuna
day3_afternoon_yuna_warning.text: "Don't run away tomorrow. The expectations you built -- see them through."

day3_afternoon_dain_talk.name: Dain
day3_afternoon_dain_talk.text: "At lunch... I wanted to eat with you too. Next time, let me join."

day3_afternoon_dain_sorry.name: Dain
day3_afternoon_dain_sorry.text: "...Fine. But you better keep that promise."

day3_afternoon_dain_promise.name: Dain
day3_afternoon_dain_promise.text: "Really?! Then you're forgiven!! Better be ready for my spike!!"

day3_afternoon_normal.name: Me
day3_afternoon_normal.text: *A peaceful after-school. Time to get ready to head home.*

day3_afternoon_transition.name: Me
day3_afternoon_transition.text: *I'm about to walk out the school gate when...*

day3_afternoon_multiple_wait.name: Me
day3_afternoon_multiple_wait.text: *...Why is everyone standing at the school gate?*

day3_afternoon_multiple_no_seoyeon.name: Me
day3_afternoon_multiple_no_seoyeon.text: *Several people are standing by the school gate. Are they all waiting for me?*

day3_afternoon_three_way_2.name: Me
day3_afternoon_three_way_2.text: *Seoyeon and Yuna are glaring at each other.*

day3_afternoon_two_way_dain.name: Dain
day3_afternoon_two_way_dain.text: "Huh? Seoyeon's here too?! I was gonna walk with {name}!!"

day3_afternoon_seoyeon_walk_others.name: Me
day3_afternoon_seoyeon_walk_others.text: *I can feel their stares from behind, but... walking with Seoyeon right now feels right.*

day3_afternoon_seoyeon_walk_yuna_reactio.name: Me
day3_afternoon_seoyeon_walk_yuna_reactio.text: *Yuna is watching us from a distance. Her gaze is cold.*

day3_afternoon_seoyeon_talk_walk.name: Seoyeon
day3_afternoon_seoyeon_talk_walk.text: "...{name}. Let's take the riverside path. The sunset is pretty today."

day3_afternoon_seoyeon_sunset.name: Me
day3_afternoon_seoyeon_sunset.text: *The sunset glitters off the river. Seoyeon's face is bathed in orange light.*

day3_afternoon_seoyeon_sunset_2.name: Seoyeon
day3_afternoon_seoyeon_sunset_2.text: *She stops suddenly and stands in front of me* "...{name}. I need to ask you one thing."

day3_afternoon_seoyeon_sunset_3.name: Seoyeon
day3_afternoon_seoyeon_sunset_3.text: *With the sunset behind her, Seoyeon's eyes gleam* "Tomorrow... you'll see only me, right?"

day3_afternoon_seoyeon_pinky.name: Seoyeon
day3_afternoon_seoyeon_pinky.text: *Seoyeon holds out her pinky* "Then pinky swear. Break your promise... and you swallow a thousand needles."

day3_afternoon_seoyeon_hand.name: Seoyeon
day3_afternoon_seoyeon_hand.text: *Seoyeon's hand trembles, then grips mine tightly* "...Idiot. Holding hands out here, what are you thinking."

day3_afternoon_seoyeon_try.name: Seoyeon
day3_afternoon_seoyeon_try.text: *A flicker of disappointment crosses her face before she smiles* "...'Try.' That's a bit of a letdown."

day3_afternoon_seoyeon_freetalk.name: Me
day3_afternoon_seoyeon_freetalk.text: *Walking along the riverside with Seoyeon as the sun goes down.*
day3_afternoon_seoyeon_freetalk.context: Walking the sunset riverside path with Seoyeon. She asked 'see only me tomorrow' and they had a pinky swear or hand-holding moment. A romantic atmosphere.
day3_afternoon_seoyeon_freetalk.personality: Seoyeon is the cool-beauty type. Sharp-tongued, composed, with a sly charm. She's possessive and bluntly direct when jealous.

day3_afternoon_seoyeon_talk_walk_2.name: Seoyeon
day3_afternoon_seoyeon_talk_walk_2.text: "This is just our time together. Right?"

day3_afternoon_seoyeon_guilt.name: Me
day3_afternoon_seoyeon_guilt.text: *'Just our time.' The other promises flash through my mind.*

day3_afternoon_seoyeon_happy.name: Seoyeon
day3_afternoon_seoyeon_happy.text: "Heh, me too. See you tomorrow. Sleep well."

day3_afternoon_seoyeon_angry.name: Seoyeon
day3_afternoon_seoyeon_angry.text: "...Fine. This weekend will make it clear who you actually care about."

day3_afternoon_yuna_talk_walk.name: Me
day3_afternoon_yuna_talk_walk.text: *Walking a quiet road with Yuna. Neither of us speaks, but it feels comfortable.*

day3_afternoon_yuna_cat.name: Me
day3_afternoon_yuna_cat.text: *A small cat is curled up by the side of the road. Yuna stops.*

day3_afternoon_yuna_cat_2.name: Yuna
day3_afternoon_yuna_cat_2.text: *She kneels down quietly and strokes the cat* "...I'm glad you're here with me."

day3_afternoon_yuna_cat_3.name: Me
day3_afternoon_yuna_cat_3.text: *Watching Yuna pet the cat... she's so gentle.*

day3_afternoon_yuna_cat_pat.name: Yuna
day3_afternoon_yuna_cat_pat.text: *Our hands meet on top of the cat* "...Warm."

day3_afternoon_yuna_head_pat.name: Yuna
day3_afternoon_yuna_head_pat.text: *She freezes under my hand* "...Are you petting me?"

day3_afternoon_yuna_head_pat_2.name: Yuna
day3_afternoon_yuna_head_pat_2.text: *Closing her eyes* "...Don't stop. Just a little more."

day3_afternoon_yuna_cat_watch.name: Yuna
day3_afternoon_yuna_cat_watch.text: *Picking up the cat* "...This one looks like you, {name}. Warm and... clueless."

day3_afternoon_yuna_freetalk.name: Me
day3_afternoon_yuna_freetalk.text: *Walking side by side with Yuna. Her expression is softer than usual.*
day3_afternoon_yuna_freetalk.context: Walking home with Yuna after petting a cat together. Yuna's expression is gentler than usual.
day3_afternoon_yuna_freetalk.personality: Yuna is languid, blunt, and marches to her own beat. She speaks in short, cryptic sentences. Cold on the surface, but there's a gap when she opens up.

day3_afternoon_yuna_warning_walk.name: Me
day3_afternoon_yuna_warning_walk.text: *There's a strange weight to Yuna's voice.*

day3_afternoon_yuna_late_warning.name: Me
day3_afternoon_yuna_late_warning.text: *I thought I saw something strange flash in Yuna's eyes... must have been my imagination, right?*

day3_afternoon_dain_talk_walk.name: Dain
day3_afternoon_dain_talk_walk.text: "{name}! See that convenience store over there?! I'm dying of thirst!!"

day3_afternoon_dain_store.name: Me
day3_afternoon_dain_store.text: *Dain charges into the convenience store. She skids to a halt in front of the ice cream section.*

day3_afternoon_dain_store_2.name: Dain
day3_afternoon_dain_store_2.text: "You pick for me! If I pick, I'll want to buy everything!"

day3_afternoon_dain_ice_share.name: Dain
day3_afternoon_dain_ice_share.text: *Her face goes red at the sharing suggestion* "Sh-share?! That's an indirect... n-no it's not! It's just sharing!!"

day3_afternoon_dain_park.name: Me
day3_afternoon_dain_park.text: *Dain and I sit side by side on a park bench nearby. Eating ice cream and watching the sunset.*

day3_afternoon_dain_park_2.name: Dain
day3_afternoon_dain_park_2.text: *Suddenly goes quiet* "...{name}. I actually couldn't sleep last night."

day3_afternoon_dain_park_3.name: Dain
day3_afternoon_dain_park_3.text: "You said you'd come watch my practice tomorrow... you're really coming, right? You're not gonna bail?"

day3_afternoon_dain_pat.name: Dain
day3_afternoon_dain_pat.text: *As I pat her head, Dain's face flushes* "I'm not a little kid, you know! ...But don't stop."

day3_afternoon_dain_freetalk.name: Me
day3_afternoon_dain_freetalk.text: *Sitting on a park bench with Dain, eating ice cream and chatting.*
day3_afternoon_dain_freetalk.context: Sitting on a park bench after sharing ice cream. Dain said 'I couldn't sleep last night' and is being more serious than usual.
day3_afternoon_dain_freetalk.personality: Dain is a puppy-energy type who loves physical contact and is fiercely competitive. Exclamation mark machine. Tsundere. Upbeat on the outside, sensitive on the inside.

day3_afternoon_dain_talk_walk_2.name: Dain
day3_afternoon_dain_talk_walk_2.text: "I want to show you my cool side, {name}!"

day3_afternoon_dain_cheer.name: Dain
day3_afternoon_dain_cheer.text: "Hehe... hearing that makes me want to try even harder!"

day3_afternoon_reject_all.name: Me
day3_afternoon_reject_all.text: "Sorry, I want to walk alone today."

day3_afternoon_reject_reaction.name: Me
day3_afternoon_reject_reaction.text: *Everyone's expressions freeze. I can feel the disappointment in their eyes.*

day3_afternoon_nobody_waiting.name: Me
day3_afternoon_nobody_waiting.text: *...Nobody's there. I'm the idiot for getting my hopes up.*

day3_afternoon_alone_walk.name: Me
day3_afternoon_alone_walk.text: *I walk home alone. What kind of day will tomorrow be?*

day3_afternoon_single_wait.name: Me
day3_afternoon_single_wait.text: *Someone is standing by the school gate.*

day3_afternoon_teacher_wait.name: Teacher
day3_afternoon_teacher_wait.text: "{name}, got a moment? Want me to give you a ride?"

day3_afternoon_teacher_ride.name: Me
day3_afternoon_teacher_ride.text: *I got in Teacher's car. The drive home is washed in sunset colors.*

day3_afternoon_teacher_ride_2.name: Teacher
day3_afternoon_teacher_ride_2.text: *Driving quietly* "...{name}. Being alone together like this... it's a strange feeling."

day3_afternoon_teacher_ride_3.name: Me
day3_afternoon_teacher_ride_3.text: *We stop at a red light. She quietly touches the back of my hand.*
choices: *Quietly rest my head on her shoulder*

day3_afternoon_teacher_hold.name: Teacher
day3_afternoon_teacher_hold.text: *She holds her breath* "...When the light changes, we let go. Promise."

day3_afternoon_teacher_stop.name: Teacher
day3_afternoon_teacher_stop.text: *She smiles wistfully* "...You're right. I need to get a grip."

day3_afternoon_teacher_lean.name: Teacher
day3_afternoon_teacher_lean.text: *She flinches in surprise... then quietly strokes my hair* "...The light hasn't changed yet."

day3_afternoon_teacher_freetalk.name: Me
day3_afternoon_teacher_freetalk.context: In Teacher's car on the way home. After holding hands or leaning on her shoulder in the sunset.
day3_afternoon_teacher_freetalk.personality: Teacher has a dry sense of humor. Seems blunt on the surface, but there's a gap when she catches herself having feelings for a student.

day3_afternoon_teacher_arrive.name: Teacher
day3_afternoon_teacher_arrive.text: *Arriving in front of my place* "Don't forget our Sunday museum date. I'll be waiting."

day3_afternoon_nurse_wait.name: Nurse
day3_afternoon_nurse_wait.text: "Oh my, {name}. I was just heading out and here we are."

day3_afternoon_nurse_walk.name: Me
day3_afternoon_nurse_walk.text: *Walking side by side with the Nurse. She's looking at the back of my hand.*

day3_afternoon_nurse_band.name: Nurse
day3_afternoon_nurse_band.text: *She suddenly takes my hand and sticks a bandage on it* "...You've got a scratch here. You didn't notice?"

day3_afternoon_nurse_band_2.name: Me
day3_afternoon_nurse_band_2.text: *There's no scratch... did she just want to hold my hand?*

day3_afternoon_nurse_caught.name: Nurse
day3_afternoon_nurse_caught.text: *Caught red-handed, her face flushes* "...Sharp eye, huh? It's just... a teacher's mark."

day3_afternoon_nurse_hold.name: Nurse
day3_afternoon_nurse_hold.text: *She freezes mid-step... then grips my hand tightly* "...Dangerous kid. Let's stay like this for ten seconds."

day3_afternoon_nurse_freetalk.name: Me
day3_afternoon_nurse_freetalk.context: Walking home with the Nurse. She used a bandage as an excuse to hold his hand.
day3_afternoon_nurse_freetalk.personality: The Nurse is playful, alluring, and mature. She's torn between her feelings for the student and her ethics as a teacher.

day3_afternoon_nurse_arrive.name: Nurse
day3_afternoon_nurse_arrive.text: "Sunday evening, 7 PM. Don't forget. I'll be waiting."
